name: mynah-eou-it-120m
input: 16 kHz mono PCM16 (Mynah); float or PCM16 WAV at 16 kHz (NeMo)

precision.mynah_cuda_server: bf16 (default, own-tc-bf16-rowstable); f32 available, CPU f32 == CUDA f32

decode: frame-synchronous greedy RNNT, max 10 symbols per frame, no beam, no LM

eou.runtime_reset: Mynah: encoder caches + decoder state reset after the chunk holding the <EOU> (= NeMo voice-agent reset_state)
eou.characterisation_reset: decoder only (prediction network to zero, last token SOS), one encoder pass (finetune/eou/diag/s2_reset.py, examples/transcribe_nemo.py)
eou.difference: transcripts differ only after a premature <EOU>

finalisation: results: 2.0 s of -75 dB quiet appended; Mynah stream flushes at end of input
text_normalisation_for_scoring: NFKD, lowercase, combining marks removed, [^a-z' ] -> space (s2_reset.norm)
runtime_tested: mynah-asr v0.9.1 (runtime sources identical from 52e5271 through 6d485b5)
